_doc: Copy to local.json (gitignored) and fill in. installPath: the game's install root, the folder holding Client/. exportRoot: the FModel export's Client folder, the one holding Content/Aki/. slimRoot / patchRoot (optional): the two slim game roots tools/plan-export.mjs links — base paks plus hotfix paks, and hotfix paks alone.
slimRoot: <slim root, e.g. a folder named WuWaSlim>
patchRoot: <patch-only slim root, e.g. a folder named WuWaSlimPatch>
